title: Oracle dispatch machine
statement: Define a deterministic Turing machine with four work tapes, Boolean symbols, and the oracle-dispatch states, whose initial state is boot. Its transition table is the one specified by the dispatch states and the scanned work-tape symbols: it updates or moves the four work-tape heads and contents according to the boot, bookmark, origin, save, read, restore, depart, and back cases, and otherwise leaves the tapes unchanged and retains the current state; it emits no output symbol and does not halt in any case.
